limitations: Human MOS/ABX, ECAPA/pYIN real-audio calibration, and SIP/PBX tests remain NOT_RUN (fake DiT/VAE + M06 used in structural tests).

gate_reasons.F5B_RNG_ISOLATION: Request-local IsolatedRngAdapter + ItemRngSpec draws true-shape initial noise without global RNG mutation
gate_reasons.F5B_TRUE_LENGTH_LAYOUT_UNPADDING: BatchLayoutBuilder stacks true-length latents with deterministic 0.0 pad and TRUE_IS_VALID frame_mask; DecoderAdapter.decode_batch_unpadded decodes per-item unpadded latents
gate_reasons.F5B_VERSIONED_CACHE_PRIVACY: VersionedCacheStore + CanonicalCacheDescriptor enforce default BYPASS, PII BYPASS, allowlisted public templates, session-confined private cache, monotonic TTL, and retired_bytes borrower accounting
gate_reasons.F5B_QUALITY_GUARD: QualityGuard enforces structural/collapse/silence/DC/duration checks with rms_dbfs=None on zero energy and QualityStatus.UNKNOWN unless calibrated
gate_reasons.F5B_SAME_SEED_RECOVERY: SameSeedRecoveryPolicy defaults disabled; when enabled retries at most once with unchanged seed/plan and blocks on uncertain/quarantined/cancelled/expired state
gate_reasons.F5C_ADAPTIVE_SOLVER_PROFILES: AdaptiveProfileSelector preserves Euler32 baseline by default, supports SHADOW metadata comparison, protects critical speech from downgrade, and maps F4-C speed controls cleanly
gate_reasons.F5C_DEADLINE_BATCH_BUCKETING: DeadlineBatchFormer under M06 enforces P2/P4/P7 isolation, zero wait for urgent P2, length bucketing with max_padding_fraction<=0.25, and MemoryBudget admission
gate_reasons.F5C_SPEAKER_PITCH_SEAM: SpeakerIntelligenceEvaluator provides isolated CPU-safe cosine similarity and autocorrelation F0 seam, rejecting unconsented/non-lab manifests with identity_verified=False
gate_reasons.F5A_REGRESSION_PRESERVED: All 80 F5-A tests + 9 F5-B/C tests passed (89 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped)
gate_reasons.PASSIVE_IMPORTS: Clean passive import of backend.neural_synthesis verified in isolated subprocess without torch/cuda/librosa/backend.models
gate_reasons.HARDWARE_AND_MOS: Real GPU/CUDA inference, ECAPA/pYIN calibration, and human MOS remain NOT_RUN
